title: Bring's surface and $q$-flatness obstructions
html:
Bring's surface satisfies QU-to-QOU lifting with \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0) = -6, the topological Euler characteristic of the base curve. The obstruction classes \kappa_n, which by item 3 of the QU-to-QOU theorem vanish exactly for n \mid 6 and persist for n mid 6, obstruct smooth lifting at the levels n mid 6, creating twisted sectors that control inertial mass and the three lepton generations. These correspond to the three pairs of branch points under S_3 \subset S_5.

In the realization tower of the motivic substrate, the non-vanishing \kappa_n eq 0 for n mid 6 implies that the Frobenius character of Bring's surface is non-trivial at every finite place p mid 6. The three lepton generations then correspond to the orbits of the cyclotomic Galois group on the six branch points. The fact that there are exactly three generations is a Galois-theoretic statement, not an analytic count.
